Discover nearby Pomona Mills Park and the Richmond Hill Dunlap Observatory. Perfect for family adventures and nature lovers in the vibrant area between Markham and Richmond Hill.

✦ Cleaning services are available upon request (additional fee may vary)

✦ The minimum age required for check-in is 21 years old.

✦ Please ensure you have a valid ID for check-in, as it is mandatory for entry.

✦ Check-in is available from 04:00 pm, and is flexible afterwards. If you expect to arrive later, please let us know as soon as possible to make the necessary arrangements.

✦ Public or shared fitness center open 24/7, available in the property.

✦ Indoor shared pool available all year, opened from 8:00AM to 10:00PM.

There are several additional things to note:

✦ A credit/debit card is required at check-in for a $150 per night refundable deposit, returned after check-out if no damages occur.

✦ Pets are welcome. CAD $95 fee for stays of up to 7 nights

✦ We use multi-unit listings, so rooms are similar but may have small differences.

✦ Complimentary laundry facilities are available on-site.

### \*Cozy Condo/King Bed/Pool/Gym/CityViews/Walkscore 91

Calgary!

Experience the best of Calgary from our stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment with stunning views. Located in the vibrant Beltline area, our home boasts a walk score of 91, ensuring convenience and accessibility to the city's top attractions, dining, and entertainment!

The Space:

Our spacious apartment features two bedrooms and two bathrooms, perfect for families or groups of friends traveling together. Enjoy modern amenities and tasteful decor that creates a cozy and inviting atmosphere throughout.

Location:

Situated in the heart of Calgary's Beltline, our home offers proximity to excellent dining options, trendy cafes, and the bustling 17th Avenue with its vibrant nightlife. You'll be just a 15-minute walk from the Scotiabank Saddledome and BMO Centre, making it ideal for sports fans and event attendees.

Amenities:

Guests have access to the building's outdoor pool and gym facilities, perfect for staying active or relaxing after a day of exploring the city. Secure underground parking and 24-hour security ensure your peace of mind throughout your stay.

What's Nearby:

Explore the diverse culinary scene right outside your doorstep, or take a leisurely stroll to nearby parks and green spaces. Whether you're here for business, pleasure, or both, our central location makes it easy to experience all that Calgary has to offer.

Ideal for:

Business travelers seeking comfort and convenience

Families looking for a home away from home

Groups of friends exploring Calgary's vibrant culture

Book your stay today and discover the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style in the heart of Calgary!

search_snapshot.note: Third-party search snapshot; not a Stay Master rate or offer.

records.description_excerpt:
### 3Beds Ground-Level Private Suite in Burnaby

⭐ Please note that there is no kitchen and no laundry available ⭐

Enjoy a comfortable stay in this private two-bedroom space in Burnaby. The suite includes two bedrooms and one full bathroom with a private entrance. One bedroom features a queen bed, while the other includes two single beds, making it ideal for couples, families, or small groups. Clean, cozy, and conveniently designed for a relaxing stay.

Layout & Amenities

• Private accommodation with a separate private entrance

• 2 rooms:

• 1 room with a queen bed

• 1 room with two single beds

• 1 full bathroom with shower and all essentials

• No kitchen or laundry facilities

• Small appliances provided for convenience:

Microwave、Electric kettle、Mini fridge、Coffee maker

• One bedroom is equipped with a TV, Disney+ subscription included

• 1 on-site parking space provided

Location

• 200 m (about a 3-minute walk) to a bus stop, Bus 101 provides access to a SkyTrain station

• Lougheed Town Centre Shopping Mall: 3 km, 10-minute drive

• Burnaby Lake Park: 1.5 km, 5-minute drive

• Grocery stores: 1.4 km, 3-minute drive

• SkyTrain station: 3.5 km, 8-minute drive

• Costco: 2 km, 8-minute drive

• Deer Lake: 7 km, 15-minute drive

• Simon Fraser University (SFU): 8 km, 15-minute drive

• Eating plaza / restaurants: 2.5 km, 10-minute drive

Please be aware that you will have exclusive access to this private two-room accommodation. Other residents live in separate parts of the house, and there are no shared indoor spaces.

To maintain a peaceful environment, quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM.

No parties or smoking are permitted. If you have visitors, please ensure that the total number of people on the property does not exceed 6, in accordance with city bylaws and the room size.

If you are bringing pets, please add all pets to your reservation. The pet fee will be applied automatically once the pets are added. Undeclared pets are not permitted.

Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
